newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard blames Oppn for Australia's jobless.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard blames Oppn for Australia's jobless.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Thursday the former Labor government was "overwhelmingly" responsible for Australia's 8.8 percent unemployment rate.

"The high unemployment we have at the present time is overwhelmingly a product of your government's failure," Howard told the opposition. "It is an outrageous breach of political combat for the Labor government to now shed crocodile tears over the high rate of unemployment that you left us to mop up."
The unemployment rate rose to 8.8 percent in August from 8.5 percent in July and 8.4 percent a year earlier.
Howard said the unemployment figures would not improve until the policies of the coalition government were operational.
"It is perfectly obvious to everybody in Australia that for the last 10 years at least we have been on the wrong track with unemployment in this country and that a new approach is required," he said.

"Until we are able to get our industrial relations policy through the Senate, until we are able to get our budget through the Senate and until we are able to get other policies into operation, you (the opposition) have no moral or political credibility to criticise our performance on unemployment."
